_meanings:
A particle (originally an imitative sound) expressing
.²1 Remembrance or recollection; {#huM jYAtam#} or {#rAmo nAma baBUva huM#}
 {#tadabalA sIteti hum#}.
.²2 Doubt; {#cEtro huM mEtro hum#}.
.²3 Assent; <ls>U. 5. 35</ls>.
.²4 Anger.
.²5 Aversion.
.²6 Reproach.
.²7 Interrogation. (In spells and incantations {#hum#} is often found used
 with <ab>dat.</ab>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} {#oM kavacAya hum#}). ({#huMkf#} means ‘to utter
 the sound {%hum%}’, ‘to roar, grunt, bellow’, as in {#anuhuMkf#} ‘to
 roar in return’; {#anuhuMkurute GanaDvaniM na hi gomAyurutAni kesarI#} <ls>Śi. 16. 25.</ls>).

.²1 uttering the sound ‘hum’; {#pfzwA punaH punaH kAntA huMkArEreva BAzate#}.
.²2 a menacing sound, sound of defiance; {#kzatahuMkAraSaMsinaH#} <ls>Ku. 2. 26</ls>;
 {#huMkAreReva DanuzaH sa hi viDnAnapohati#} <ls>Ś. 3. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 58</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 54</ls>.
.²3 roaring, bellowing in general.
.²4 the grunting of a boar.
.²5 the twang of a bow.

.²1 an incantation.
.²2 the grunt of a wild boar.
.²3 the roar of thunder.
